title: Microsoft Priva Privacy Risk Management: data overexposure policies for Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake Storage and Amazon S3
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, commands and controls are supported, and it distinguishes the launched roadmap item from the narrower preview documentation. Minor corrections concern an omitted heading in the policy activation path and checklist controls without corresponding table rows.

claims.claim: The roadmap extends Priva data overexposure policies to Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake Storage and Amazon S3.
claims.quote: Microsoft Priva Privacy Risk Management extends its overexposure policies into data contained in Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Amazon S3.
